difficulty_rationale: Level 4: pnpm workspace with symlinks under node_modules. Historically Fettler aborted the whole scan on any symlink. Correct behavior: skip and record symlinks, complete the scan, migrate the one real source file, and do not follow symlinks into packages/payments twice.

faults.description: Provider renamed the charge payment-instrument field `source` -> `payment_method` between API v1 and v2; consumer is on v1.

notes: apps/web/src/pay.js has no literal `source` and must not be flagged. Symlinks must be recorded as skipped, not silently dropped.
